svg.title: Refined layered flat-vector person rig candidate
svg.desc: A headless layered person rig with explicit pivots at the waist, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, and ankles.
svg.metadata: Candidate status: unapproved visual direction. Construction: deterministic layered SVG; no generated raster content. Coordinate system: -80 0 880 1080 viewBox, with clearance for the longer torso and thicker limbs. Naming convention: rig-* groups are animation targets; art-* groups are visual-only layers.
